gold_clauses.title: Definitions
gold_clauses.key_quote: "Confidential Information" includes all technical, business, and financial information disclosed by Disclosing Party

gold_clauses.title: Non-Disclosure Obligations
gold_clauses.key_quote: Receiving Party shall hold and maintain the Confidential Information in strictest confidence

gold_clauses.title: Term and Termination
gold_clauses.key_quote: This Agreement shall remain in effect for a term of three (3) years from the Effective Date

gold_clauses.title: Governing Law and Jurisdiction
gold_clauses.key_quote: This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of India

gold_risks.title: Extended Confidentiality Obligation
gold_risks.why_it_matters: Confidentiality obligations persist for 3 years after the effective date.
